# Three.js landing background

`three-0.128.0.min.js` is the unmodified `build/three.min.js` from the official
[`three@0.128.0`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.128.0) npm package.
It is served locally to preserve the existing r128 landing animation without
requiring a visitor to reach cdnjs. It remains deferred and is skipped on small
screens, reduced-motion devices and data-saving connections.

The upstream MIT license is included in `LICENSE`. Package tarball integrity:
